chunks: Sulayman b. Ahmad al-Lakhmi narrated to us. He said: al-Hadrami narrated to us. He said: Abbad b. Yaqub narrated to us. He said: Thabit b. Hammad narrated to us from Musa b. Suhayb from Ubada b. Nasi from Abdullah b. Abi Awfa. He said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) made brotherhood bonds between his companions and left Ali (peace be upon him) out. So he said to him: You have made brotherhood bonds between your companions but you left me out? So he said: By the One in whose hand is my soul, I have not left you behind except for myself. You are my brother, my deputy, and my inheritor.

He said: What will I inherit from you, O Messenger of Allah? He said: What the prophets before me bequeathed. They bequeathed the Book of their Lord and the tradition of their prophet. And you and your two sons will be with me in my palace in Paradise.

key_terms.سنة نبيهم: The tradition of their prophet - prophetic practice
key_terms.كتاب ربهم: The Book of their Lord - divine scripture
key_terms.مواخاة: Mu'akhat - the brotherhood pact established by the Prophet between his companions
key_terms.وصي: Wasi - deputy, executor, or designated successor

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali's status when making brotherhood bonds between his companions?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates the event of the mu'akhat (brotherhood pact) in Medina, when the Prophet established fraternal bonds between the Muhajirun and Ansar but initially excluded Ali. When Ali questioned this, the Prophet declared that Ali was reserved for himself as his brother, deputy (wasi), and inheritor. The Prophet further clarified that prophetic inheritance consists of divine scripture and prophetic tradition, and promised Ali and his sons a place with him in Paradise.

en.bilal-muhammad: Sulayman b. Ahmad al-Lakhmi narrated to us. He said: Al-Hadrami narrated to us. He said: `Abbad b. Ya`qub narrated to us. He said: Thabit b. Hammad narrated to us from Musa b. Suhayb from `Abada b. Nasi from `Abdullah b. Abi Awfa. He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) made brotherhood bonds between his companions and he left `Ali (as) out. So, he said to him: You have made brotherhood bonds between your companions, but you have left me out. So, he said: By He in whose hand is my soul! I have not left you to yourself. You are my brother, my deputy, and my inheritor.

He said: What will I inherit from you, O Messenger of Allah? He said: What the prophets have inherited before me. They inherit the Book of their Lord and the tradition (sunna) of their prophet. You and your sons will be with me in my palace in Paradise.
